description:
On your upkeep, activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}.
On your draw step, create two Bear tokens.
Activate two Bear tokens by tapping itself, adding one mana of any color.
Activate World of Wilding by paying {2}.
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing a Bear token, creating four Bear tokens and discarding three cards.
Activate two Bear tokens by tapping those, adding two mana of any colors.
Repeat from step 4.
